description: This source file defines a ShellExecutor responsible for executing shell commands asynchronously, capturing their output, handling timeouts, and reporting execution results.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A static executor providing methods to run shell commands asynchronously, with detailed output and timeout handling.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a shell command with optional working directory, environment variables, and timeout, returning detailed results.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Simplified method that wraps 'runDetailed' and returns a 'Response' object indicating success, message, and payload.

classes.name: ShellResult
classes.description: A structure capturing the output, error, exit status, timeout status, and success flag of a shell command execution.
